🔧 Core Features

# UI / UX

Currently, I have no designs or templates for this website. Pls give me some references if u have ones, otherwise, it's up to u (but prioritize simple UI design)

- Simple, funny website design (responsive included)
  - fonts
  - colors (prioritize using tailwind colors)
- Dark/light/system mode support
- Optional dynamic theming based on mood selection

# Mood Picker (Mandatory):

- Creative mood selection using emojis, GIFs, and quirky mood names
- Text input with playful AI parsing for mood detection

# Category Selection:

- Standard categories like film, video, music, memes.
- Use list of icons for user to select category to save the width, height.

# Suggestion Generator:

- Generate items based on user's needs

- Generator for film:
  --> Show list suggestion films
  --> Each item contains image, name, category, link for the films

- Generator for music / video:
  --> Embedded youtube link in website
  --> Displays as carousel layout

- Generator for memes
  --> Integrate AI for painting memes or using apis.

# Future features:

- User management: signup, signin (with gg, fb,...)
- Collaborative Moods: "15 people are feeling 'meh' right now - join their watch party!"
- Mood Journal: Optional micro-journaling with AI-generated prompts based on mood
